name: Submit a self-service loan application
goal: Look up the member by member number, open their profile, and click 'Apply for Loan'. Select the given purpose from the dropdown (exact option text) and enter the given amount. Submit the application. Read back the application reference shown on the confirmation screen.

inputs.name: purpose
inputs.description: Loan purpose, exact option text from the dropdown (e.g. 'Auto', 'Personal').

outputs.name: application_ref
outputs.description: The loan application reference shown after submission.

business_outcomes.description: The member number does not exist.
The loan amount was below the minimum or above the self-service maximum.

known_interstitials.description: Host-maintenance session notice that occasionally interrupts navigation.
